# OpenLineage schema fixture

`OpenLineage-2-0-2.json` is the unmodified official schema from
https://openlineage.io/spec/2-0-2/OpenLineage.json, retrieved on 2026-10-22.
OpenLineage is licensed under Apache-2.0. The pinned Python SDK emits this version.
Keeping the schema local makes contract tests independent of external availability.
